details: pdf.Open and PDF object resolution in rsc.io/pdf recurse without bound on nested arrays and dictionaries. A sufficiently deeply nested document exhausts the goroutine stack limit and triggers a fatal, uncatchable stack overflow. Any service that parses untrusted PDFs with rsc.io/pdf can therefore be taken down by a single small input.
summary: Uncatchable stack-overflow denial of service in rsc.io/pdf
